title: A screen-tall hero with dvh
summary: min-height: 100dvh fills the visible screen, even when a phone's address bar shows and hides.
explanation: 100vh is the height of the viewport, but on phones it is measured with the browser's toolbars hidden, so a 100vh section is taller than what you actually see and its bottom is cut off.

100dvh (dynamic viewport height) follows the toolbars as they appear and disappear. svh is the smallest size (toolbars shown) and lvh the largest. min-height rather than height lets the section grow if its content is taller.
body { margin: 0 } removes the browser's default 8px margin, which would otherwise add a scrollbar to a full-height section.
tryThis: Remove the body rule: a scrollbar appears because 100dvh plus 16px of margin is too tall.
Change min-height to height and add several paragraphs: the content overflows instead of the hero growing.

children.text: This section fills the visible screen.
